input.conditions: n>=1; n-1 once-listed edges; valid source; connected; CSR validates endpoints

output.conditions: Owned uint32 source distances, eccentricities and diameter certificate

constraints.errors: Invalid domain rejected; documented arithmetic overflow rejected; allocations propagate; see complete contract

complexity.operations: O(n) time and storage; O(1) stack; returned 8n bytes on 64-bit
complexity.guarantee: Worst-case asymptotic bounds, no calibrated latency or peak-memory claim

memory_lower_bound.scope: Conservative allocated payload lower bound, not peak or feasibility proof

evidence.correctness: Documented sweep, DP and tree metric invariants; not formal verification

provenance.implementation: Independent engineering implementation; source supplies problem entry and motivation
